candidates.description: This vector represents French indefinite determiners and pronouns denoting quantity, variety, or unspecified identity.
This vector activates in contexts related to major characters, authors, and proper nouns from the Harry Potter universe.
This vector activates in contexts related to magic, fantasy role-playing elements, and arcane spellcasting.
This vector is related to common French prepositional and conversational subwords, particularly variations of the word "pour" (for) and "dans" (in).
This feature activates on suffix morphemes and adjective-forming suffixes denoting capability or possibility.
This vector is related to words starting with the prefix "ap-" or "cap-".
This vector represents adjectives denoting significance, scale, or capability.
This vector activates for common French auxiliary and linking verbs expressing states of being, possibility, and time.
This vector activates on common French adverbial modifiers and conjunctive adverbs of time, degree, and logical relation.
This feature vector represents different facets, perspectives, or conceptual versions of a subject.
